# X-Ray
> Spatial posts over live camera, on this device. Privacy-first mixed reality for phone, tablet, and desktop.

- Version: 4.0.0
- Codename: Grounded Reality
- Live: https://x-ray.jonbailey.xyz/
- Signaling: https://xray-signal.jonbailey.xyz/
- Original experimental app: https://x-ray.grok.me/
- Concept: @suddenlyjon
- Network host: Pitchfork-and-Torch / jonbailey.xyz
- License: MIT
- Source: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/x-ray

## One-liner
Your posts. Your room. On this device. Import a file you already have, lock cards in the room, and keep places on this phone. Camera frames are not uploaded. This host does not fetch X.

## What it does
- Place Memory: named rooms stored on this device (orientation-relative pins, not a 3D scan)
- Feed Bay: import JSON, NDJSON, markdown, or an X archive file you already have
- Anchored Reality: device orientation locks cards in physical space (graceful scroll/pointer fallback)
- Live camera passthrough with glass post cards at near / mid / far depth
- Demo Reality ambient mode when camera is denied or for a quick try
- Re-anchor writes the new origin into the active place
- Walk-safe chrome hides controls while scrolling
- Handle labels (Vectors) and Shared Reality anchors over a data channel (no camera share)
- On-device insight bubbles; optional client-side xAI key for richer insights
- Local gallery in IndexedDB (stills + Moments); download / Web Share API
- Ambient lighting tint from camera average color
- i18n: EN (locale fan-out paused)
- PWA manifest + service worker for installable shell

## What it does not do
- Does not fetch X or any live social API
- Does not upload camera frames, photos, or motion
- Does not share camera media in Shared Reality rooms
- Does not require an account

## Privacy
- Camera streams via getUserMedia stay in the tab
- Motion sensors processed on-device only
- Captures stored only in IndexedDB / download
- Shared Reality can exchange SDP, ICE, presence, handle labels, and small anchor JSON or reactions while a room is active
- Anchors sync only while the data channel is up. NAT may block rooms. No TURN server
- Signaling worker stores SDP and ICE only, TTL 2 hours; never stores video or post bodies
- Optional Enrich sends post text to api.x.ai only if you paste a key and tap Enrich
- hits.jonbailey.xyz may record page loads, not camera

## Deep links
- `/?demo=1` - open Demo Reality
- `/?xray=1` - open stage (requests live camera)
- `/?room=CODE` - join Shared Reality room
- `/?room=@a,@b` - open with vector handles
- `/?lock=0` - force scroll depth mode
- `/?whatsnew=1` - open What's new
- `/?place=ID` - open a saved place on this device
- `/?places=1` - open Places
- `/?feed=owned` - show the imported feed
- `/?import=1` - open Feed Bay

## FAQ
Q: Does video leave my phone?
A: No. Camera frames stay in the tab. This site does not upload video, photos, or motion.

Q: Why motion sensors?
A: So posts can stay fixed in the room as you turn. Sensor data is not sent. Scroll depth works without sensors.

Q: Does this fetch my X feed?
A: No. This host does not fetch X. Import a file you already have.

Q: Do places remember the real wall?
A: They remember orientation-relative pins on this device. Not a 3D scan.

Q: Relation to x-ray.grok.me?
A: x-ray.jonbailey.xyz is the Anchored Reality network host. x-ray.grok.me remains the original experimental SPA.

Q: Do Shared Reality rooms work across phones?
A: Signaling at https://xray-signal.jonbailey.xyz/ stores SDP and ICE only. Anchors sync only while the data channel is up. NAT may block rooms. Same-tab rooms still work without the worker. Camera never leaves.
